disposition_reason: Forty commercial jasmine flower cakes from 32 Chinese producers were analysed by ICP-MS for eight elements; Table 3 prints every sample value and Table 4 the summary statistics.

study.design: national retail survey of jasmine flower cakes with health risk assessment
study.origin: 32 producers in Yunnan, Fujian, Zhejiang, Jiangsu, Guangxi, Shandong, Sichuan, Hebei, Anhui and Beijing
study.method: microwave HNO3 digestion; ICP-MS (Agilent 7700x, He mode, internal standard)
study.qa: spike recoveries 86.34-107.84%, RSD 0.74-4.26%; blanks; no CRM reported
